fidelity: F2a — Coupled Cavern + TES Energy-Balance ODEs (physics-lumped)
source: ADELE project (RWE/GE/DLR/Zunft 2009-2013); Wolf & Budt (2014) Applied Energy 125:158 (LTA-CAES); Budt, Wolf, Span, Yan (2016) Applied Energy 170:250; Barbour et al. (2015) Renewable & Sustainable Energy Reviews 45:598
description: 0D lumped first-principles A-CAES. Charge: multi-stage compression heat captured into a sensible-heat TES (no heat rejected to atmosphere). Discharge: cavern air re-heated by stored TES heat (NO fuel combustion) then expanded. Two coupled ODEs: cavern air-mass/energy balance and TES energy balance, integrated with scipy.solve_ivp. RTE 0.65-0.75, strictly above diabatic CAES (~0.42-0.54).

unit.name: Generic A-CAES (ADELE-class) — Cavern + Sensible TES
unit._air_properties_comment: Air thermodynamic properties at ~300-600 K, treated as ideal diatomic gas. cp, cv, R, gamma from Lemmon et al. (2000) J.Phys.Chem.Ref.Data 29:331 (NIST REFPROP air) and Cengel & Boles Thermodynamics 8th ed. Table A-2.

R_air.source: Cengel & Boles Table A-2 (dry air gas constant)

cp_air.note: Used for compression-heat and re-heat energy balances

unit._tes_medium_comment: TES medium = packed concrete/rock sensible-heat store (ADELE design uses solid-media regenerator). cp_tes from Khare et al. (2013) Sol.En.Mat. and Laing et al. DLR concrete-TES; basalt/rock ~ 850, high-T concrete ~ 916 J/(kg.K).

cp_tes.source: Laing et al. (2006) DLR solid-media concrete TES; basalt rock-bed

m_tes.source: Sized so Cm_tes=m_tes*cp_tes=1.62e10 J/K can re-heat the full cavern throughput (m_usable~9.3e6 kg x 335 kJ/kg / 0.9 ~ 3.5e12 J over dT=252 K)
m_tes.note: ~18000 t solid regenerator media (ADELE 350 MWh-class TES)

T_tes_design.note: Design TES charge temperature ~277 C (multi-stage compression heat, ADELE)

T_tes_ambient.note: Ambient reference for TES heat loss

UA_tes.note: TES insulation conductance; tau_tes = Cm_tes/UA_tes = 1.62e10/9e4 = 1.8e5 s ~ 50 h

unit._cavern_comment: Solid-rock cavern, isothermal-ish coupling to host rock via UA. Geometry from ADELE/Huntorf-class salt cavern.

cavern_thermal_mass.note: Effective rock-wall thermal mass coupled to cavern air

UA_cavern_rock.note: Cavern-air to rock conductance; tau_cav = 5e9/5e4 = 1e5 s ~ 28 h

specific_work.note: Compressor specific work at design (multi-stage to 70 bar)

specific_expansion_adiabatic.note: Expander specific work at full TES re-heat; E_out=335*0.86*0.97=279.9, E_in=310/(0.80*0.97)=399.5, RTE=0.700

k_comp_T.note: Compressor specific-work sensitivity to intake T

unit._diabatic_reference_comment: Diabatic CAES (Huntorf/McIntosh) RTE for the >-than constraint. Huntorf 0.42, McIntosh 0.54 (Barbour 2015).

rte_diabatic_reference.note: A-CAES RTE must exceed this (no fuel penalty)

physics_notes.rte_a_caes_design: 0.700 at design (T_amb=288.15K, TES fully charged at 550K)
physics_notes.fuel_free: fuel_power == 0 always (key A-CAES advantage vs diabatic CAES)
physics_notes.conservation: Charge: E_to_air + Q_to_TES (less machine losses) = E_elec_in. Discharge: E_elec_out drawn from cavern exergy re-heated by TES.
